//: Copy to parvis.config.json next to the tree you want governed. Every key is optional; precedence is flag > env > this file > default. Read protocol/07-INTERFACE.md section 3 before changing host.
//allowNonLoopback: Binding a non-loopback address publishes the console, and edit access to your unlocked documents, to your network. There is no user authentication. Requires this second opt-in so it cannot happen by a single slip.
//editableDirs: Relative to root. Only .md files directly inside these directories are listed and editable. Must not be absolute and must not escape the root.
//lockedFiles: Readable in the UI, never writable through it, at any estop state. An interface that can edit the stop is not a safety interface.
//operator: Name written into REQ rows and stop reasons. null falls back to the OS username.
